decision: Selected the midpoint of the two generator stack positions that Odense Kommune's environmental approval of 28 October 2021 for Cassin Networks ApS gives for Bygning 1 and Bygning 2 (the two data halls of the first phase, with the administration building between them), transformed from ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N (EPSG:25832) to WGS84, as the campus locator for Meta's Odense Data Centre in Tietgenbyen.

selected_properties.document: Miljoegodkendelse til Cassin Networks ApS, Odense Kommune, 28 oktober 2021 (69 pages); anlaegsadresse M. P. Allerupsvej 48, 5220 Odense SOE; CVR 36967552; P-nummer 1024584182; hovedaktivitet Datacenter
selected_properties.table: OML (air-dispersion) input table after the stack-placement section (Placering af afkast): columns Bygning 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6, row 'UTM-koordinater', one representative worst-case generator per building
selected_properties.crs_interpretation: The approval labels the values 'UTM-koordinater' without naming a datum; ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N (EPSG:25832) is the Danish public-sector standard and is confirmed by all five points falling inside the EPSG:25832 outline of lokalplan 4-1022 'Udvidelse af datacenter i Tietgenbyen' served by Plandata.dk.
selected_properties.location_text: Section 2.5 Beliggenhed: the data centre and its emergency power plant lie in the western part of Tietgenbyen; the new data halls are to adjoin the existing data centre; the company's total area is about 92.3 ha; the area is covered by lokalplan 4-1022, which replaces the three local plans that regulated the data centre's land. The approval also places a cooling yard by the administration building between Bygning 1 and 2.
selected_properties.lokalplan_4_1022: Plandata.dk WFS pdk:theme_pdk_lokalplan_vedtaget planid 10796505, plannr 4-1022, plannavn 'Udvidelse af datacenter i Tietgenbyen', kommune Odense (461), adopted 2021-10-27, in force 2021-10-28, status V (vedtaget), MultiPolygon in EPSG:25832

computed.transform: pyproj 3.7.1 Transformer EPSG:25832 -> EPSG:4326, always_xy=True; rounded to 7 decimals
computed.method: Read the UTM table from the approval with pdftotext; transformed with pyproj 3.7.1; containment and boundary distances computed with shapely 2.1.1 in EPSG:25832 against the lokalplan MultiPolygon; geodesic distances on the WGS84 ellipsoid (pyproj Geod). No geocoder, commercial map, map viewport, PeeringDB or OpenStreetMap service was used.
